rules.content:
title: Fake Tracking ID (FTID) Refund Fraud Indicators
status: experimental
description: Detects indicators of fake tracking ID (FTID) refund fraud, where a customer claims a package was not received or returned by providing a manipulated or fabricated tracking number. Indicators include 
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: returns_processing
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "refund_request"
        refund_reason|contains:
            - "item_not_received"
            - "return_in_transit"
    filter_tracking_anomaly:
        tracking_delivery_address_match: false
    filter_weight:
        tracking_package_weight_oz|lt: 4
        order_expected_weight_oz|gt: 16
    filter_known_pattern:
        tracking_id_pattern_match: "ftid_known_format"
    condition: selection and (filter_tracking_anomaly or filter_weight or filter_known_pattern)
level: high
rules.title: DL-0062: Fake Tracking ID (FTID) Refund Fraud Indicators (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Abnormally High Refund Rate Per Customer Account
status: experimental
description: Detects customer accounts with an abnormally high refund-to-order ratio over a rolling window. Accounts exceeding a refund rate of 40% across 10 or more orders within 90 days are flagged as potential 
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: order_management
detection:
    selection:
        event_type|contains:
            - "order_completed"
            - "refund_issued"
    aggregation:
        condition: "selection\n| groupby(customer_account_id)\n| where count(event_type='refund_issued') / count(event_type='order_completed') > 0.4\n| where count(event_type='order_completed') >= 10\n"
    timeframe: 90d
    condition: selection | aggregation
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0063: Abnormally High Refund Rate Per Customer Account (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Return Without Receipt Clustering by Customer or Region
status: experimental
description: Detects clusters of product returns submitted without receipts or order references from the same customer identity or geographic region. Organized return fraud rings often exploit no-receipt return po
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: returns_processing
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "return_processed"
        receipt_provided: false
        order_reference_matched: false
    aggregation_customer:
        condition: "selection | count() by customer_account_id > 4"
    aggregation_region:
        condition: "selection | count() by store_region_code > 15"
    timeframe: 30d
    condition: selection | aggregation_customer or selection | aggregation_region
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0065: Return Without Receipt Clustering by Customer or Region (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: High-Value Item Not Received Claims Exceeding Threshold
status: experimental
description: Detects "item not received" (INR) claims filed on high-value orders that exceed a configurable dollar threshold. High-value INR claims are a primary vector for refund fraud, particularly when the deli
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: order_management
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "dispute_filed"
        dispute_reason: "item_not_received"
    filter_high_value:
        order_total_usd|gte: 500
    filter_delivery_confirmed:
        carrier_delivery_status: "delivered"
    filter_repeat:
        account_inr_claims_90d|gte: 2
    condition: selection and filter_high_value and (filter_delivery_confirmed or filter_repeat)
level: high
rules.title: DL-0066: High-Value Item Not Received Claims Exceeding Threshold (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: UCP Returns Logic Hijacking — Void Return and Verify Step Bypass
status: experimental
description: Detects exploitation of the UCP returns state machine where AI agents skip the order.return.verify step and trigger settlement.refund.instant() using fraudulent tracking IDs (e.g., void-000). Threat a
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: ucp_returns
detection:
    selection_void_tracking:
        return_tracking_id|startswith: "void-"
    selection_verify_skip:
        return_verify_step_completed: false
        refund_method: "settlement.refund.instant"
    selection_no_shipping_scan:
        shipping_scan_validated: false
        refund_issued: true
    aggregation_velocity:
        count|gte: 10
        groupby: "merchant_id"
        timeframe: "1h"
    condition: selection_void_tracking or selection_verify_skip or (selection_no_shipping_scan and aggregation_velocity)
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0125: UCP Returns Logic Hijacking — Void Return and Verify Step Bypass (Sigma)
